items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Oh, and speaking of 'Lush Life,' it brings to mind Billy Strayhorn. I told you before that we were friends.

ctx.x: That should be interesting to hear.

And 'See You Later, So Long' is going to be one of them. I've also done an arrangement on 'Lush Life,' which is one of my favorite things of all time. Oh, and speaking of 'Lush Life,' it brings to mind Billy Strayhorn. I told you before that we were friends. And here's something that I know very few people would know: That our band, Lee and Lester's band, played 'A Train' before Duke ever saw it.
